Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production independent rotating and moving game sprite components, Mindustry Daoist reskin. Use the attached approved mail and party images as hand-painted style/material references only: jade green, ivory enamel, warm gold edges, subtle rounded cloud ornament, crisp refined hand-painted modeling. Never draw the UI, letters, people, scene or background. Other attached unit sheets are shape/identity references; extract their component design language, do NOT draw any whole aircraft or chassis. Strict orthographic TOP-DOWN dorsal view; weapons point straight toward the top edge, not frontal/isometric perspective. Every component complete and independently isolated, including its full round or square pivot base; no cut seams or body fragments. Truly transparent RGBA around every object, clean antialiased outer edges, no cast shadows, no glow haze, no backdrop, no checkerboard, no labels, numbers, text or dividers. Preserve subject opacity, no arbitrary semitransparent metal. Invisible regular cells for placement only, keep at least 15% empty margin around each object and generous transparent gutters; objects must never touch or overlap.
Requested 3072×3072 square. Exactly NINE isolated individual weapons, 3 columns × 3 rows in this reading order. The unit sheets attached after the two style images are assault aircraft, support aircraft, Erekir aircraft. Use the support craft tool-emitter language for the Incite engineering mount.
ROW 1: (1) Zenith: slim triple missile launcher with three distinct ivory rockets, gold tips, jade side cradle and round bronze pivot underneath. (2) Antumbra: broader round rotating triple missile turret, three forward rockets and thick armored jade/gold circular base; visually different from Zenith slim rack. (3) Antumbra: compact rotary multi-barrel machine cannon, dark metallic barrels toward north, jade armored cylindrical turret housing with ornate circular pivot base.
ROW 2: (4) Eclipse: a single long laser cannon, ivory jade longitudinal casing with amber emitter strip and complete rotating circular rear base, no wing. (5) Eclipse: compact short twin-barrel artillery turret, two northward short barrels and round ivory/jade pivot casing. (6) Mega: small jade-green repair emitter head, single luminous green lens toward north, short white casing and complete gold ring pivot base, no arm or body.
ROW 3: (7) Incite: compact engineering tool emitter, green crystal tip to north, short jade-white mechanical housing and complete circular mounting base; not a whole builder. (8) Quell: FOUR distinct missiles in one square launch basket, ivory rockets, gold frame, jade hinged side braces and complete pivot base. (9) Disrupt: FIVE distinct missiles in one wider heavy launch basket, stronger gold armor frame, jade side panels and full rotating base. All missile baskets face north. Draw no extra loose rockets or accessories.
